title: Steamed Buns
text: “Wow, this is a blatant Usaunny-only gimmick, huh?”
“Switching straight to Motoyasu-san, are we? Please go grab that.”
“Itsuki sure has a lot of demands.”

With that, I promptly switched characters and vaulted over the wall to touch the altar, I say. Then light enveloped me. Oh? My body started moving on its own, indeed. I thought I’d simply hopped—boing!—when suddenly I jumped again off of nothing but empty air!
“What is the meaning of this?”
I jumped once more as a test, and sure enough, the moment I focused, I could land on nothing but empty space and jump again.
“A double jump… does that mean there’s a gimmick that powers up the pioneer creatures’ racial traits, too?”

“Probably means we’re meant to clear that ledge from earlier with a double jump. Checking the map, there seem to be other paths that don’t require any power-ups. Those probably have their own bosses, and defeating them likely unlocks gimmicks like this one that we need to collect to progress.”
“How troublesome… I don’t want to power up. There’s no telling what might happen.”
A double jump, I say! Boing, boing, indeed!
“Onward we go, indeed!”

And so, we backtracked and used our double jumps to clear the wall and press forward, I say! In that manner, we advanced through every reachable area of the grounds. Most of the boss drops turned out to be Class Up transformation items. There were Class Up items for special bosses among monsters used in ground maintenance, like Dunes, as well as items to strengthen insect-type monsters through special Class Ups—all sorts of items sorted by type.

Further ahead, we were able to power up our pioneer creatures as well. As mentioned, I got the double jump. Ren, as the Inult, gained the ability to phase through walls and create a clone that mirrored his movements. Itsuki, as the Riska, apparently gained the ability to glide—jumping now drastically reduced his falling speed. Father, as the Peckul, gained the ability to wrap himself in ice and freeze enemies in place for a set duration.
“I finally got an attack method too—oh wait, it just freezes them, no damage at all…”
“Thoroughgoing to the very end, isn’t it? Very on-brand for you, Naofumi-san.”
“I guess that’s just how it is, being the Shield Hero.”
Right then, Rival smiled and placed her hand on Father’s shoulder, the nerve of her!
“Naofumi, that part’s Gaelion’s job, along with everyone else’s. It’s something all of Naofumi’s companions across every world genuinely feel, so nano, don’t worry about it, nano.”
She stole the very line I wanted to say, right out from under me! Rival, you scoundrel!… Are you trying to score points here?!
“Gaelion-chan… Motoyasu-kun is glaring at you like a vengeful spirit. And Yuki-chan watching from behind him looks pretty intimidating too, so maybe ease up a little.”
“You’re trying to seduce Father the moment Big Sister and Older Sister aren’t around to stop you! I won’t allow it, indeed!”
“Wrong, nano. Gaelion’s telling Spear Hero to finally understand already, nano.”
Such words will not deceive me, I say!

“Sheesh, nano. Spear Hero, this worry of Naofumi’s—the very first Raph you ever knew surely said the same thing, nano. Gaelion’s just speaking on her behalf. She’s not seriously saying she’s the only one meant to attack, nano.”
Acting all mature now, are we?! I know your game! Using that attitude to seduce Father! Father is weak to reliable types, after all!
“Besides, you’re just as much an attacker as anyone, nano. Just properly lend Naofumi your strength, nano.”
“Honestly, Motoyasu-san and Gaelion-san have completely swapped mental ages, haven’t they.”
“Back in the day she used to fawn all over Naofumi trying to get his virginity, causing all sorts of ruckus. Feels like a lie now.”
Itsuki and Ren were comparing me to that creature! This must be her scheme, I say!
“Father! Do not let yourself be seduced, indeed!”
“Getting seduced in a moment like this seems unlikely… but I get what Gaelion-chan’s trying to say. I’ve got Motoyasu-kun, and Ren and Itsuki too.”
“Don’t worry,” Father said with a nod, and I was reassured, indeed.
“Still, makes you wonder—did every Shield Hero throughout history struggle with this? Only being able to defend and never attack sounds pretty rough.”
“Who knows. According to Rafuemon-san and the others, the Shield Hero apparently never appears again in the future.”
“Yeah, that’s the gist of it.”
“Siltvelt might have records on that sort of thing… but Faubrey has these artifacts left behind by past heroes, including shields meant to be thrown, so I’m a little suspicious of the whole thing.”
Father said this while inspecting his shield intently.
“Anyway, since the Peckul can use a freeze technique, I guess the idea is to freeze incoming monsters and use them as footholds to advance.”
“Is there really a situation where we’d need to rely on Naofumi-san for that?”
“Well, maybe underwater sections that only the Peckul can pass through?”
“Ah… that seems likely. So I get gliding, then? Reduced fall time, floating down slowly, it seems.”
Itsuki hopped, and sure enough, drifted down gently.
“Not a Riska—a flying squirrel, indeed!”
“Knew you’d say that! What is with this ability?! It’s so mediocre! Weapons can already let you fly through recoil, so this is basically a dead skill!”
Meanwhile, Ren, who was out on the field, kept testing his clone ability over and over.
“Seems like Ren’s taken a liking to it. The clone thing.”
“N-no! I’m just practicing so I can use it when I actually need it! If I get good enough, it might even help me escape from Luna more easily.”
“The clone is obviously see-through, so it’ll be spotted immediately. But since it looks kind of cool at a glance, you’re drawn to it, aren’t you? No need to hide it.”
“I-it’s not that!”
Ren tried desperately to cover up something that was completely obvious.
“Anyway, let’s keep moving, Ren-san. Honestly, this dungeon’s a treasure trove, and the experience points we’re earning are considerable too.”
Itsuki, apparently having given up on subtlety, briskly ordered Ren to get a move on.
“Why am I the one going…”
“Motoyasu-san could work too, but you’re better suited for exploration, Ren-san. You can tell things apart by smell and all that.”

By the way, on a hunch, Father had me test whether I could dig through walls, and it turned out some walls really were diggable. Medicine and experience bonus items came tumbling out as the walls crumbled. And so our exploration of the grounds kept steadily progressing, I say! Along the way… we kept running into entrances leading underwater, over and over.
“…Guess it’s about time to have Naofumi handle the exploring.”
Ren said, checking the waterside and requesting a switch with Father. I’d love to go myself, but the water here follows the same rules as the last dungeon—I can’t swim, indeed.
“Hm? My turn?”
“Yeah… wait, I hear some kind of sound. Naofumi, what are you doing?”
Ren could only tell what was happening on our end by sound alone. As for what Father was doing while staring at the screen…
“What am I doing? Well, since we were talking earlier about making the island’s signature dish, I figured I’d research it by making steamed buns shaped like the pioneer creatures.”
With a whoosh, Ren returned through the portal to the entrance, and turned to look at all of us, including Father, who was busy making steamed buns with a steamer.
“Making them here, of all places? Seriously, Naofumi?!”
“Well, I don’t get much screen time, and Itsuki kept shooting me looks like ‘if you’re just going to watch, at least make something,’ so I had no choice but to do it.”
“A promise is a promise!”
“I helped too, indeed!”

I lent a hand with my fluffy paws, indeed. Getting to learn cooking directly from Father was quite educational. This time, Father prepared prototype steamed buns modeled after each of us. He pulled the finished buns out of the steamer and held one out to Ren.
“The Inult steamed bun, indeed. Filled with pork inside, indeed! I have thoroughly confirmed the contents, indeed!”
“Gaelion and the others brought ingredients over from the main island, nano!”
Rival had gone and procured the seasonings we were missing, indeed.
“I stepped away briefly to compile some documents to submit to Mother, and had Gaelion-san come pick me up on the way back… but honestly, you heroes really do as you please.”
It seemed Fiancée had gone to report at a spot on the main island where communication was possible. What a surprisingly lax dungeon, letting us just pop out for supplies like that!
